purpose: Phase 0.5 go/no-go: predicted Flash expert I/O versus cache size and policy
scope: Offline replay of recorded expert routes. Bytes are application read ranges of whole experts; nothing here is measured throughput at these cache sizes. The recording runs are functional only: system swap counters moved during them.

source.working_tree: uncommitted Phase 0 changes on top of the commit

recording.raw_traces: Not kept in the repository; each trace is identified by its SHA-256 below. Re-record with record_routes.py.

policies.lfu_decay_slots: the runtime: equal slots per layer, slot-keyed LFU with halving decay
policies.lru_global: one byte pool for all layers, LRU
policies.lfu_ghost: equal slots per layer, expert-keyed LFU that remembers evicted experts
policies.lfu_ghost_weighted: lfu_ghost with slots allocated from the other workloads' LRU miss curves
policies.belady_per_layer: offline bound, equal slots per layer

replay.warm_definition: second half of each workload's decode tokens
